about_the_game:
Fynn's Passage is a stylized third-person shoot-n-slash game with looting, trading, puzzle elements, and more.

Sword or Gun (or both)

With your sword equipped you can slice up your enemies and execute combo attacks.

With your pulse rifle equipped you can shoot up your enemies from a distance.

Switch between the two weapons seamlessly for balanced gameplay.

Loot, Trade, and Collect

Discover collectible items as you explore. Trade with memorable NPCs to obtain Rare items. Completing a full Set will reward the player with a Charm. Each Charm will unlock a unique player buff, enhancing gameplay experience.

Environmental Puzzles

You will need to solve puzzles in order to obtain key items that are necessary to progress through the game. Each puzzle is unique and challenging.

Boss Fights

Experience grand boss fights involving a combination of solving puzzles, combat, and damage phases. Get ready to utilize all the skills you've learned up to this point in the game.

Replayable

Didn't find all items you were looking for? Playing again will Re-Roll all the collectible items in the game, giving you more opportunities to complete your collections.

Lore

All living species were forced underground thousands of years ago. Now play as "Fynn" as you seek to uncover the secrets of these mysterious caverns. Speak with NPCs to learn more about what happened in the old times. Observe unique items that bare clues to a world long past. Strive to eventually make your way to the surface in search of the truth.

short_description: Play as "Fynn" as you make your way through an underground labyrinth, fighting against mobs of malicious creatures. Switch between weapons seamlessly for balanced combat. Explore caverns, discover collectible items, trade with friendly NPCs, and solve various puzzles.
